notes:
Specifically describes the collapse or destruction of buildings and structures. Used extensively in disaster reporting, particularly for earthquakes and typhoons. Composed of {倒|とう} (topple) and {壊|かい} (destroy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倒壊|とうかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a building collapses
- {全壊|ぜんかい}/{半壊|はんかい}: total/partial collapse
- {倒壊|とうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧: danger of collapse
- {倒壊|とうかい}⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧: collapsed buildings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧: collapse, breakdown — broader; used for systems, regimes, structures
- {崩落|ほうらく}: cave-in, collapse — used for cliffs, tunnels, roofs falling in
- ⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: fall over — more general; people or objects falling
